name: Scento Perfume API
description: The perfume knowledge connector for AI assistants. Portraits, raw materials, scent pairings and occasion edits from Scento's verified perfume database: 1,400+ designer and niche perfumes and 400+ raw materials. Twelve read-only tools, no key and no account. Tools: perfume-search, perfume-portrait, scent-neighbours, perfume-contrast, note-portrait, material-match, house-portrait, family-map, occasion-edit, wardrobe-composer, perfumery-lexicon, journal-search.
